text: And these were the sons of David, the ones being born to him in Hebron. The first-born was Amnon to Ahinoam the Jezreelitess. The second, Daniel, to; Abigail the Carmelitess.
The third, Absalom, son of Maachah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur. The fourth, Adonijah son of Haggith.
The fifth, Shephatiah to; Abital. The sixth, Ithream to; Eglah his wife.
Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months. And thirty and three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
And these were born to him in Jerusalem -- Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon -- four to; Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
And Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet -- nine.
All these are sons of David besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
Sons of Solomon -- Rehoboam; Abia was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
And the sons of Josiah -- first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the sons of Jehoiakim -- Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
And the sons of Jeconiah -- Assir, Salathiel his son.
And and Melchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, and Jecamiah, and Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
And the sons of Pedaiah -- Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel -- Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed -- five.
And the sons of Hananiah -- Pelatiah, and Jesaiah his son, Rephaiah his son, Arnan his son, Obadiah his son, Shechaniah his son.
And the sons of Shechaniah -- Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah -- Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat -- six.
And the sons of Neariah -- Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam -- three.
And the sons of Elioenai -- Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani -- seven.
